Monotype font format guide: formats TTF and OTF (desktop) and WOFF/WOFF2 (web); variable font is an OpenType capability not a fifth format; EOT/SVG obsolete; format is not licence
MyFonts licence types as the purchase choice: Desktop, Company Desktop, Webfont, App, Electronic Doc, Digital Ad/Email, Server; licence counted by users, pageviews, publications or servers
Libro.fm audiobooks delivered DRM-free as zipped MP3 folders or a single-file M4B, or via app and web player; format is a delivery choice of the same title

audiobook.jp beginner guide: audio only (PDF supplement may be attached); buy per title, or unlimited-listening plan, or monthly ticket plans; app-only 'coin' currency; downloads repeatable; MP3 players via PC download

Library of Congress Recommended Formats Statement table of contents: Textual Works (print, digital, e-serials), Still Image (photographs print/digital, other graphic images, microforms), Moving Image (motion pictures, video), Audio (tangible media, media-independent digital), Musical Scores, Datasets, Geospatial, Design and 3D, Software and Video Games, Web Archives, Email

Sedo wiki: premium domains of two kinds, registry premiums (TLD operator price tiers, higher renewals) and aftermarket names; aftermarket names are owned by current registrants

German trade FAQ: two main e-book formats EPUB (reflowable, novels) and PDF (fixed layout, technical books); protection classes none, personalised watermark, Adobe DRM (.acsm licence file is not the book)

Fnac livres numeriques page: ebooks listed as 'ebook (ePub)' in product titles, sold with a subscription link (Kobo+) and Kobo reader links; format is stated in the product name; page gave no deeper category tree
tolino open system: free choice of tolino bookseller, readers compatible with EPUB, PDF and TXT (Adobe DRM capable)
Chinese Kindle guide: mobi (KF7/KF8) vs azw3 (mobi in a DRM wrapper) vs epub (universal, supported by all readers except Kindle app); formats explained by device compatibility

BOOTH digital goods ideas: backgrounds, decoration, frames, textures, CLIP STUDIO and Photoshop brushes, Photoshop/Canva templates, VRoid textures, 3D models, fonts, e-books/PDF, digital planners; listing fields: file format, resolution, supported software, commercial use, redistribution

Adobe Stock asset types: photos, vectors, illustrations, templates, 3D assets, videos, motion graphics templates, audio tracks; file formats per type (JPEG, PNG, AI/EPS, MOV, OBJ/EXR/HDR/MDL, PSDT/AIT/INDT); licence types by use; fonts separate service
IANA labels TLDs generic, generic-restricted, sponsored, country-code, infrastructure; 22 gTLDs before 2012; 1,241 strings delegated from 2012 round

Google Fonts: genre classes serif, sans serif, slab serif, monospaced, script, handwriting, display (loose, overlapping); separate historical classes humanist, transitional, geometric, grotesque; classes mainly for Latin script
Adobe Fonts: Classification filter has eight type classifications (sans serif, script, decorative...) plus separate expressive tags (e.g. clean)

LoC RFS still images: digital photographs and other graphic images split by raster vs vector; preferred formats TIFF, JPEG2000, PNG, JPEG/JFIF (uncompressed, highest bit depth up to 16 per channel); acceptable PSD, DNG, proprietary camera raw (.nef .crw .arw .iiq), GIF; vector SVG preferred, EPS and PDF acceptable

LoC RFS moving image: motion pictures (digital and physical) vs video (file-based, physical); file-based preference order IMF, FFV1 in Matroska, ProRes in QuickTime .mov, MPEG-2, XDCAM; MPEG-4 .mp4 only a viewing proxy; files must carry no DRM
